title: I'd pass.
text: I'd pass.. Only get this if you plan to put stiff, heavy books and magazines in it. If you put medium catelogs and soft covers, they slump over and don't stand up. I tried putting a piece of cardboard cut to fit in the bottom but that didn't help. The item is well made and just as pictured and described - but it just doesn't work very well for me.
